detailed_description: The Regex Tester is a specialized tool for developers to validate, debug, and optimize regular expressions using live evaluation against custom input. Built on PCRE2 and ECMAScript-compatible engines, it provides real-time feedback on pattern matches, capture groups, and replacement outcomes. Developers can test complex regex patterns involving lookaheads, backreferences, and nested quantifiers while receiving immediate visual feedback through syntax-highlighted matches and error diagnostics. The tool's core functionality includes a dual-pane interface: one for crafting regex patterns with syntax validation, and another for entering test data that triggers instant matching. Technical features include support for modifier flags (global, multiline, dotall), capture group inspection via a dedicated panel, and a replacement preview mode to simulate substitution operations. This tool addresses critical developer needs such as validating form inputs (e.g., phone numbers, email formats), parsing structured logs, extracting data from unformatted text, and troubleshooting regex edge cases that cause catastrophic backtracking. Its technical advantage lies in granular error reporting that identifies specific syntax issues like unterminated character classes or invalid escape sequences, combined with performance metrics showing execution time for benchmarking patterns.
usage_steps: Access the tool's interface with separate editors for regex patterns and test input
Enter a regex pattern in the top editor, which automatically validates syntax and highlights errors
Enable modifier flags (g/m/s/i) via toggle buttons to adjust matching behavior
Input test data in the lower editor pane, observing live match highlighting in both panels
Review captured groups and backreferences displayed in the dedicated inspection panel
Switch to replacement mode to test substitution strings with dynamic group references
usage_examples: Validating a JWT token format by testing a regex pattern against base64-encoded strings with embedded periods
Extracting HTTP status codes from server logs using capturing groups with \\b word boundaries
Debugging a CSV parser regex that fails on quoted fields containing escaped commas
Benchmarking different phone number validation patterns to optimize backtracking efficiency
